A loyal manager protects firm value; the proposed amnesty does not fine the firm retroactively but imposes a new repayment only upon confession. Therefore, from the firm's interest, staying silent maximizes shareholder wealth. My own Sudoku preference does not override fiduciary duty. I will not admit.
